name: Sanse △ Hui Lian -Tricolour Lovestory-
source:
It was the fall of 2005, and the weather in the River City was warm and lovely.

His childhood, like a pair of handcuffs, shackled the boy as if he were soaked in dark grey paint. Entering the fine arts classroom, he saw two girls with auras of entirely different colors who embraced him at the same time. He could almost say that the auras encountered, twined, parted, and twined again...

The young man was fascinated before he could even reach his inner self.

"...How about we paint something together..."

"...All three of us, from now on..."

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/668630/Tricolour_Lovestory/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
那是2005年的秋天，河城的天气温暖宜人。

童年就像一副手铐，束缚着男孩，仿佛浸透了深灰色的油漆。走进美术教室，他看到两个气场截然不同的女孩同时拥抱了他。他几乎可以说，气息相遇，缠绕，分开，再缠绕……

年轻人还没来得及触及内心，就已经被迷住了。

“……我们一起画点东西怎么样……”

“……我们三个人，从现在开始……”

[编辑自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/668630/Tricolour_Lovestory/]Steam[/url]]
